confidence_notes: The FX figure is the RBA overview rate for 18 Nov 2026, found through search. Food and drink anchors come from three web searches. Those searches returned crowdsourced or modelled cost-of-living aggregates (Numbeo, Wise, Digital Nomads, Citycost, Stamped Nomad, Tripbase), which disagree with each other, especially on the mid-range meal for two (about $16 to $41). The beer, cappuccino and inexpensive meal figures cluster fairly tightly. The search for cocktail and wine prices found no actual prices, so I set cocktail and wine by assuming a typical Thai tourist-island premium over beer (cocktail about 2.5 times beer, wine about 3 times beer). Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge, with no booking pages or listings inspected. They vary a lot by season and beach, and I assumed a shoulder-season July. Hostel supply on Koh Lanta is limited, so the hostel figures are especially uncertain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Cost-of-living aggregates for Koh Lanta itself, cross-checked against other Andaman and Gulf island destinations such as Koh Phangan and Koh Lipe. Koh Lanta is somewhat cheaper than Phuket, with a relaxed, lower-density tourism profile.
